question_suffix: Answer with a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.
hypothesis: Response-format mismatch contributes to the gap between short reference likelihood and verbose greedy answers
metrics: native content-answer mean logprob excluding EOS
normalization: Same E11 NFKC/casefold/remove Unicode punctuation/collapse whitespace; keep articles and negation
success_criterion: Support format-alignment hypothesis only if >=4/8 generations shorten, mean paired reference logprob rises >=1.0 nat, and normalized exact matches increase >=2/8; otherwise criterion not met
interpretation: Format/behavior diagnostic only. Even meeting criterion is not weight editing, new-fact replacement, semantic clinical accuracy or independent generalization. Do not relabel previous edits successful.
selection: Same8 original audited train targets as E11/E12; no selection by current response, no changed references, no fabricated medical data; same3 images
controls: Clean native BF16 Base, fixed mistral_instruct template, original arm must exactly match E11 Base tokens; parameter version counters and selected matrix must remain unchanged
changed_field: Only a fixed question suffix; no optimizer, matrix write, adapter, checkpoint or Judge
stop: Any original generation mismatch, parameter change, nonfinite metric or wall cap stops and preserves raw outputs/costs
followup: If format criterion passes, separately freeze a matched edit study with aligned prompt and actual answer-target criterion before seed confirmation. If it fails, do not search many prompt wordings; analyze objective/constraint inadequacy.
